scenes.vo: When health factor drops below 1, a liquidator (usually a bot) repays part of your debt (up to the close factor, often 50%) and takes that value of your collateral plus a bonus (the liquidation penalty, often 5–10%). Liquidations sell collateral into a falling market, which can push prices lower and trigger more liquidations: a cascade.
